rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for the next event or item, whether temporal or sequential.

example.jyutping: gan1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when “then” refers to a particular time in the past, rather than to what happens next.

example.english: Back then, I still lived in Mong Kok.
example.jyutping: go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 zung6 zyu6 hai2 wong6 gok3

rows.note: Use this in a conditional result meaning “in that case, then,” usually before the consequence.

example.english: If you don't want to go, then stay home.
example.traditional: 你唔想去，咁就留喺屋企啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 gam2 zau6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa1
